questions.question: What did King Hezekiah do with the threatening letter from Assyria's king Sennacherib in the house of the LORD?

answers.text: Spread it out before the LORD

questions.question: King Hezekiah prayed for the LORD to save Judah from Sennacherib. What reason did Hezekiah give?

answers.text: So all kingdoms know the LORD alone is God
So Judah can finally rule over Assyria
So the people keep trusting their king

questions.question: Through the prophet Isaiah, what did the LORD say He would do to Sennacherib for his rage and arrogance?

answers.text: Put a hook in his nose and send him back
Let him take the city for a season
Hand his kingdom to the king of Cush

questions.question: When the LORD promised to defend Jerusalem from Sennacherib, whose sake did He name besides His own?
